question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution: The correct answer is **"possible."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Possible** means something that can happen or exist. (संभव (जो घटित हो सके या किया जा सके), शक्‍य) • **Example**: *Is it **possible**__ to buy tickets in advance?* • It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. • The sentence suggests that the blank requires a word that describes a situation that can happen. • The correct answer is Option 2. • Correct passage: In a busy bus station, there is a little girl sitting all __alone__ on a bench. She stares at the floor as all the busy travellers rush __around__ her. Some of the people are in such a big hurry that they do not __notice__ her. Other people look at her, but continue running to where they need to go. After some time, a man stops next to the girl. He is very tired after a long day of work, and he just wants to get to his home as quickly as __**possible**__ so that he can be with his family. But he cannot just leave this little girl alone. He cannot see her ______ (5) ______ anywhere. The little girl is no older than his own little daughter. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Potential** means having the capacity to happen or develop in the future. (जिसके कुछ होने, प्रयोग में आने आदि की संभावना हो; संभाव्‍य) • **Believable** means able to be believed; convincing or plausible. (जिसका विश्‍वास किया जा सके; विश्‍वसनीय) • **Credible** means able to be believed; convincing or trustworthy. (विश्‍वसनीय; विश्‍वास करने योग्‍य) 46:Te67, The correct answer is **"parents."**
